summary: KNOREX Ltd. (NYSE American: KNRX), a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) announcing a strategic carve-out of wholly owned publisher-monetization subsidiary AscendX Media Technologies Pte. Ltd. AscendX would be separated and independently capitalized by external investors, with KNOREX expecting to retain a minority equity interest. No price, stake percentage, premium or timeline is disclosed; investor discussions are ongoing and completion is not assured. Retaining equity preserves upside while ending KNOREX's funding obligation; watch for disclosed investor terms, retained stake size, and any shareholder or regulatory approvals.
